summary: The meeting reviewed the upcoming mobile release, covering an Android crash, analytics migration, beta‑testing tasks, Dark Mode timing, and App Store review questions. The team assigned Neha to fix the crash by March 3rd, agreed to switch analytics to Mixpanel, postponed Dark Mode to the next release, and noted pending items such as the push‑notification bug and release‑notes distribution.
